balls.text: Two byes to end the innings. Offcutter well outside off, he fails to connect and they scramble for a bye. Mishra was a goner with a direct hit but Kishan missed and a misfield from Sakib helped them get two
Offcutter on off, he pushes through covers and misses
Another swipe, another miss. Slower outside off, he looks to go downtown and fails to connect. Another dot
Jadeja stays at the non-striker's end. Slower offcutter on off, Mishra goes for a cross-batted swipe and misses. Mishra wanted a bye and was out had Kishan missed.

They are trying for two and Burger is run out. Why would they attempt a second run when the more established batter is at the non-striker's end? That is pretty poor cricket. Slower offcutter outside off, he pats this to deep point where Malinga fires a good throw. Burger is just short when Kishan whips off the bails
Slower back of a length ball outside off, he pulls to deep midwicket

Caught right on the boundary and Abhishek has taken a good catch. Or has he? The third umpire has been called to have look. Looked like a clean catch on first instance. Yep, it is. Low full toss on off stump, he gets it right off the cue-end of the bat but only as far as Abhishek at long-on, who catches and on realising he is close to the ropes, lobs the ball up and completes the catch
Lovely bowling. Wide yorker just inside the tramline outside off, Archer tries to jam that wide but misses
Finds the gap and gets four.  Low full toss well outside off, he frees his arms and thrashes that to the left of extra cover
Full outside off stump, Archer shoulders arms but the ball has landed well inside the tramline
Fuller outside off stump, he crashes that only as far as Cummins at extra cover

Ferreira goes for two... surely he is short? Yeah, he is. Fuller outside off, he squirts it to deep backward point where Shivang is slow onto the ball. Ferreira senses a chance and eyes a second, but Shivang's throw is flat and close to the stumps. Ferreira dives but is unable make his ground as Kishan whips off the bails in a flash
A boundary for Jadeja and RR are nearing 250! Full on leg stump, Jadeja gets his legs out of the way and nudges this fine and Cummins has conceded 64 off four overs!
Slower back of a length ball outside off, he pulls to the right of Abhishek at deep midwicket and they get two more
Yorker on off stump, he shovels this to long-on and they get two more
Slower back of a length ball outside off, he cuts to backward point and a misfield from Shivang gets them two
Slower short of a good length ball outside off, he slaps this to long-off

That is some stunning running from Ferreira and Malinga is slow onto the ball. Slower length ball down leg, he works this to deep backward square leg. Ferreira wanted the second, Jadeja is pushed into it. A throw at the bowler's end and Jadeja was a goner
Fuller outside off, he gets it down to long-off
Edged and four. Rising good length ball outside off stump at 140kph, Ferreira throws his hands at it, gets a thick outside edge that flies to the right of the keeper
Another pacy bouncer on middle, he pulls to deep midwicket

Jadeja wants a single but is sent back and would have been run out with a direct hit. Banged in short on middle, he mistimes his pull to Cummins at midwicket and sets off, but is sent back. The throw is, however, wide
On a length on middle, he pushes back to the bowler with a straight face of the bat

Very high but not long enough and Shanaka falls early. Length ball at 141kph on off stump, Shanaka stays leg side of the ball and looks to go across the line. The bat twists in his hands and he gets more height than distance and only as far Abhishek at long-on
Nails the yorker on off stump, Ferreira can only jam this to extra cover
Skiddy short of a length ball on off, Ferreira is rushed into the pull and mistimes to deep midwicket
On a length on off, he works this to deep backward square leg with soft hands but can only muster a run
Wayward delivery and Shanaka is up and running. Length ball down leg, he steps across and tickles this fine

Doesn't have enough legs to clear long-on and Klaasen takes a comfortable catch. Length ball on off stump, Parag flat-bats to long-on but not off the middle of the bat. Klaasen goes reverse-cupped and makes no mistake
Sharp good length ball on off stump that hits Parag high on the right leg as he misses the pull
Sharp good length ball on middle and leg, he helps this to short fine leg and a misfield allows them a run
A skimmer and Parag gets six more! Back of a length ball on off stump, Parag thumps that away flat and over deep midwicket

More fortune for Parag. Another leading edge and this goes for four, but Parag won't be bothered. Length on off stump, he wanted to flick that away, gets a leading edge that goes over short third. RR raise 200 in the 15th over
Length ball on off and middle, he pushes to long-on
Length ball on the off stump, he whisks this to long-on
Leading edge but away from the fielder. On the fuller side of length on off, he wanted to flick that away, but gets a leading edge that goes to the right of backward point

Banged in short on middle, Ferreira ducks under. Do RR want to review the wide? There is some discussion ongoing. Yep, Parag has reviewed for the third bouncer of the over which wasn't given. The third umpire has a look and the graphics confirm that the ball was under the shoulder. RR lose a review.

Gets lot of height but not enough distance and Hinge has a second wicket. Pacy back of a length on off stump, Jurel pulls but doesn't generate a lot of power in his shot. The ball goes up and Reddy at deep square leg, completes a good catch

Juuuuust over deep backward point's head. Jurel has raced to a fifty off just 20 balls. This has been some innings from the keeper-batter. Short and wide, he cuts and gets enough power to clear a leaping Sakib
Length ball decking back into Parag on middle, he swipes this to deep midwicket
On a length on off stump, he pushes to the offside and sets off

A bit of top-edge but Jurel will only be concerned about the four. Banged in short on leg stump, he pulls and those fast hands mean that even with a soft top-edge the ball flies to the deep fine leg fence
Nails the yorker on off, Parag can only dig this out to point
Whippage from Parag! Low full toss on Parag's pads and he whips this away with disdain to the left of deep backward square leg
Slower back of a length ball outside off, he flays this to deep backward point
Mistimed but goes over mid-off and gets two more. On a length outside off, Jurel was trying to go deeper into the stands again but the bat turns in his hands and he miscues over Klaasen's head
Slower bouncer but way too high outside off, called a wide
Some extra bounce for Malinga. Sharp short of a length ball outside off, Jurel looks to steer that fine, is hit on the gloves with the ball going to the right of the keeper who dives and intercepts

Short, wide and punished. Plenty of width from Malinga to start a new spell outside off and Jurel cuts to the left of backward point. Reddy sprints and dives to his left trying to cut the boundary but the ball was flying
Pacy short of a length ball on off, Jurel plays the short arm jab to long-on

Oof, glorious. Cummins is being absolutely tonked around the park. Full and right in the slot on off stump as Jurel presents the full face of the blade and majestically drives through the line and all along the turf to the left of the bowler
Deep into the stands! Jurel is flying. Banged in short outside off, Jurel pulls and slams this over deep backward square leg
Fuller outside off, he drives on the up aerially to the left of extra cover for a couple of runs
Innovation from Jurel and he gets four for his effort. Fullish in length outside off, he steps across, goes for a scoop and gets it to the vacant fine leg fence
Short and wide outside off, he cuts but straight to backward point where Head intercepts
The runs are flowing again for RR. Parag into the act now.Googly but that was dragged down on off stump, Parag rocks back and pulls this over cow corner

Oh, wow Malinga's kicked that from going into the boundary. Marginally short on off, he works this tidily to the right of Malinga at deep midwicket. He sprints across, sticks out the right foot and saves three
Slog sweep deep into the stands as Jurel breaks the shackles. Tossed up in the slot on off, he gets down on one knee and hammers this over deep midwicket
A touch quicker on middle stump, he works this to deep midwicket for a run

Straight down long-off's throat. Jaiswal falls for a laborious 29 and SRH are crawling back. Floated outside off, he jumps down the track but gets too close to the pitch of the ball. Ends up skimming it to the right of Abhishek, who runs in and takes a good catch
Tossed up on middle stumps, he sweeps to deep backward square leg
Punches a length ball to cover. Just 11 runs in two overs after Sooryavanshi's dismissal
Length ball around middle, steered to backward point
Full outside off, driven away with an open face to deep point's left
Back of length delivery on leg, Jaiswal backs away and looks to dab this fine of short third, but picks the fielder
Good length delivery closer to off, steered fine on the off side now to deep third's left
Misfield from Travis Head. Back of length delivery outside off and Jurel with his fast hands cuts this behind point. It's straight to Head, who lets it through him and RR pick up a boundary
On a length outside off, cut to backward point

Full and wide, Jurel looks to whack this down the ground. Good job by Shivang to stick his hand out and deflect it to long-off. Will go down as a missed chance, but more realistically, he's saved three runs there!
Driven down to long-off
Looks to cut away this short-ish ball and misses out
On a length outside leg, clipped to deep backward square
Tossed up full, Jaiswal works it through midwicket

Oh noooo, he's picked out the fielder! Praful Hings has the last laugh (or a quiet smile at this point). Pats on the back for Sooryavanshi from the SRH players, as he walks off, castigating himself despite playing one of the most memorable innings you will see. Looks to take on a short ball by slapping it down the ground but miscues it as it lobs up towards deep third, who runs in and completes the catch, ending an all-timer of an innings
Launched over long-off! Sooryavanshi, you beauty! Full ball angled across and he gets his front leg out of the way and nails the shot.
The free hit is deposited over square leg and Sooryavanshi is into the nineties! Low full toss on middle and Sooryavanshi heaves this away

And now Hinge bowls a rather high full toss around leg, Sooryavanshi manages to swivel and glove it along to short fine leg's left. No ball called, a warning given to Hinge, and Sooryavanshi has a free hit to face
Slapped over cover point with disdain! No fielder in the deep and Hinge still goes short and wide. Well, not quite a half-tracker, but Sooryavanshi still has no problem in swatting it away
Goes for the wide yorker and Sooryavanshi tries to reach out. However, this is called wide as it goes beyond the tramline
The fielder can only watch this sail over him! In the slot around leg and Sooryavanshi flicks this away over a hapless deep square leg. 100 up for SRH in the eighth over!
Full outside off, driven out to the off side sweeper
Excellent stuff! Into the second tier as Sooryavanshi gets down on one knee to this back-of-length slower delivery and hammers it away over fine leg!
Back-of-length outside leg, sits up nicely and Sooryavanshi pulls this square. Gets it off the toe end and that's why it's only a four and not six, with the ball bouncing just short of the rope

Slower ball angled across, steered to backward point and they get a risky single in. There is a direct hit at the striker's end, but Sooryavanshi - who was slow to start that run - makes it home in time
On a length around leg, Jaiswal parries
Jaiswal, so innovative there! Short ball angled across him, and close to his body. Jaiswal gets on his toes and just helps it along fine on the off side with a ramp
Full around off, 134kph, pushed out through cover for a single
Now a yorker on the stumps, Jaiswal jams his bat down and squeezes it to backward point
Low full toss on the stumps, Sooryavanshi looks to heave it away. gets it on the bounce to deep midwicket
Jaiswal looks to come down the crease and Hinge follows him and finds the blockhole. Jaiswal is able to dig it out towards cover, where a slight misfield allows the single
Jaiswal shuffles across, Hinge looks to follow him, but Jaiswal improvises to scoop this over the keeper, fine on the leg side
Full around off, Jaiswal drills it to mid-off
Back-of-length delivery angled across him, Hinge gets away as Jaiswal misses his cut
Malinga goes for the yorker now. Sooryavanshi was initially planning to hit this leg-side but adjusts to block it back to that straight mid-off fielder
Full around off and Jaiswal caresses it wide of mid-off. Cummins does well there to keep it down to a single
Eases this down to long-on for a rare single
Even when he does something wrong, he does it right! Looks to lift this over backward point with an open face, but doesn't time it. Still gets it in the gap between backward point and cover!
Back-of-length and angled across him, this time Jaiswal can only drive it out off the back foot to deep point
Jaiswal reminds fans he's here too! This is a good length ball angled across at 141kph, but Jaiswal creams a back-foot drive through cover
And he goes bigger now! Back-of-length delivery on leg, he reads it early, gets his front leg out of the way and nails the pull over square leg. A 16-ball half-century in the Eliminator!

And Sooryavanshi has taken just 15 balls to set the record for most sixes in a T20 tournament, going past Chris Gayle's 59! Slower ball angled across him and this time he was ready for it, clearing his front leg and slamming it over wide long-off
Now the back-of-length slower ball denies Sooryavanshi, who is early into the pull. Dug in short on leg and angled across him, and Sooryavanshi doesn't read the slower one
Now Sooryavanshi falls over as he loses balance trying to swat this away. This is full and wide at 137kph, and Sooryavanshi can't reach it
And there's another one. He's levelled with Chris Gayle for most sixes in a T20 tournament!. Short step out to this slower ball and he check-drives this inside-out over extra cover
Sakib starts off with a yorker just outside off, Sooryavanshi blocks it out towards cover
Now Cummins goes for the leg-stump yorker. Sooryavanshi digs it out in front of square leg and keeps strike
Three in a row! Pat Cummins overpitches again, with a slower ball this time, and there's width on offer. Sooryavanshi clears his front leg and hammers this right back down the ground
Short, wide and punished! Sooryavanshi is on a roll here as he waits on this short ball and uppercuts it over third! Four sixes already, and he just needs three more to break Chris Gayle's record!
Chipped down the ground for another six! Right in the slot on middle and Sooryavanshi lofts it down the ground
Short and wide, and he's overdone it there with the bouncer

Oh, creamed in the gap! SRH got innovative with their field placements and Sooryavanshi takes advantage. There is an extra cover in place and mid-off is quite straight. And Sooryavanshi drives this overpitched delivery right where regulation mid-off would have stood!
In the slot outside off and Jaiswal laces a drive to cover's left. Great fielding there from Shivang Sharma to dive to his left and make the stop. Was a sureshot boundary otherwise
Boom! Vaibhav Sooryavanshi is in the mood. 140kph short ball climbs on him, but he picks the length early and he hooks it behind square for a massive six
Ooh, low full toss around leg and Sooryavanshi looks to whip it leg side. But he gets an inside edge onto his pads and the ball rolls towards point
Back of length delivery angled across him, Jaiswal just opens the blade to steer it out to deep backward point
Oooh, good comeback! Wobble-seam on a length on off, 142kph, and the ball rises quite a bit as Jaiswal misses his back-foot drive
Thick edge flies over the cordon! Full outside off and slanted across, Jaiswal goes at it hard. Thick edge and it flies over the gap between the slip fielder and short third
Full on off and angled across Jaiswal, 139kph, pushed out to cover

And there we go! This is full outside off, 141kph, and Sooryavanshi gets under it and lofts it right back over Cummins' head. We have our first six of the Eliminator, with Cummins unable to close out what was otherwise a very good first over
Back of length delivery angled across Jaiswal at 139kph, the southpaw cuts it away hard, but straight to the deep backward point fielder
Another yorker, this time outside off at 140kph, and Sooryavanshi pushes it out towards mid-off's right and sets off for the single. They are a bit hurried, but make it through in the end
Cummins' first ball to Sooryavanshi is a 139kph yorker on middle. Sooryavanshi does well to dig it out
Now it's a full inswinger around leg. Jaiswal looks to flick and gets an inside edge onto his pads with the ball rolling in front of point. RR are off the mark
Pitched up at 137kph and Jaiswal meets it with a lovely straight drive, but it's too straight and crashes into the stumps at the non-striker's end

Straight to short third and it is fitting that Sooryavanshi has a say in the final wicket of the game. Fuller outside off, he flashes at it, gets a thick outside edge that flies to Sooryavanshi who takes a good catch. RR win by 42 runs and will now face GT in qualifier 2.
Play and a miss! Good length ball outside off, he looks to go over covers and misses
Starts off with a veeery wide delivery way outside off. Would have been a wide in a Test
slower legcutter outside off stump, another wild swing from Sakib who doesn't connect again
Back of a length ball on middle, he looks to swing for the hills, doesn't connect
called a no-ball on height.  A very high full toss on middle that is swatted to the leg side. SRH have asked for a review. That's definitely above the waist.
Fuller on leg stump, he looks to slog that away, gets a thick inside-edge to the legside
Pinned in the midriff. Slower offcutter on leg stump, he is early into his cross-batted swipe and misses
Length ball on off, he gets right across attempting a scoop. He ends up toe-ending to deep square leg

Just short of the incoming Ferreira. Back of a length ball, was the legcutter outside off. He flat-bats to long-on as Ferreira runs in, but he can't reach it. Oh, Shivang is down on the ground. Cramps? Looks like. He went down immediately after playing the shot and looks in pain. The physio is out to tend to him
On a length outside off, he carves this to the left of deep cover. They don't take the run
Juuust over mid-off! Fuller on middle, he backs away big time and skims it over Ferrerira's head
Sharp back of a length ball angling back into Sakin on middle. He backs away and looks to steer it fine and misses.

The safe hands of Jofra Archer end Malinga's resistance. Back of a length ball outside off, he looks to go downtown by backing away. Ends up spooning this straight and Archer at mid-off back-pedals and does the rest
Slower short of a length ball outside off, he pats to deep point
On a length outside off stump, he throws his hands at it and gets a thick outside edge to deep third
Swing and a miss! Sharp short of a length ball outside off, he backs away and looks to go over the offside. Makes no connection
Full and down leg now, called a wide
THRASHED! Banged in short on middle, he lines up the pull and smashes it to the left of deep midwicket
Over midwicket for a couple of runs. Short of a good length ball angling back into Shivang. He swipes across the line and gets a bit of a top-edge that goes over midwicket
CRASHED over mid-off! Too full outside off stump, he clears his back leg and lofts cleanly
Good shot! Sharp back of a length ball on middle, he stays legside of the ball and ramps using the pace of the ball to the right of deep third
Angled back into Malinga outside leg, who is leg side of the ball and chips over covers for a run
Straight up but lands safely. Tossed up legbreak on off stump at 88.8kph. Malinga gets a top-edge on an attempted pull but the ball falls to the right of long-on
Gently tossed up at 84kph on middle stump, Shivang pulls to long-on
Flatter and shorter outside off, he cuts to deep point's right for a run
Another googly pushed outside off, Malinga looks to pat this and misses again
Flatter googly outside off, he looks to steer this fine and misses
Tossed up on off stump, he drags this to long-on
Fuller on the stumps, Shivang lifts this to long-on with the ball just dropping short
Very, very slow at 61.4kph (!) and down leg, he helps this to deep backward square leg's right

That's that! Arora falls for 35 and Jadeja has another. Slows this up at 87kph and well outside off stump. Arora looks to go inside out over covers, but doesn't generate enough power. Deep extra cover is placed perfectly to complete the catch
UP AND OVER! Tossed up and right in Arora's arc on leg stump, he gets under it and sends it over long-on
Solid take by Jurel. Flatter and well down leg, Jurel acrobatically dives to his left and saves four
Slower through the air outside off, he drags that to deep midwicket
Just past off stump. Pushed quicker well outside off, he looks to go downtown and almost chops this back onto his stumps
Flatter and waaay outside off, called a wide
Flatter and shorter outside off, he mistimes to long-off
Flatter outside off, he pushes to backward point with an angled bat
Dragged down again on leg stump, he pulls to deep midwicket
Flatter on off, pushed back to the bowler
Lands in no-man's land! Floated outside off, he goes for a cross-batted hoick. He gets a big top edge that goes straight up and lands where in the vacant extra cover region
Pushed quicker and down leg, called a wide
Dragged down on middle and leg, he pulls to deep midwicket
Generously tossed up outside off, he eases to long-off
On a length outside off, he drives to deep cover
Pushed quicker outside off stump, he cuts to backward point
Flatter on off stump, he mistimes his cut to extra cover
Darted well outside off almost deceiving Arora in flight. He somehow sticks his bat out and toe-ends to the offside
Tossed up on off stump, he pushes to long-off
Back of a length ball outside off, he steers to deep third

Sloppy fielding and excellence on the field both on the same ball. A high full toss outside off, he guides to Sooryavanshi at backward point who misfields with the ball heading towards the boundary. But Jadeja sprints to his left, dives and saves a run
On a length outside off, he opens the face of the bat and steers to deep backward point
Banged in short outside off, he sways outside the line of that
Full and well outside off, Shivang fails to get any bat on that
Banged in short on middle, but it's too high and called a wide

Jofra can do no wrong this evening! After three wickets, he takes a lovely catch at long-on. Mishra cramps Cummins for room angling a back of a length ball into him on off. Cummins mistimes his pull to the right of Archer at long-on, who runs to his right, takes the catch and ensures he stays inside the field of play
Length ball angling across Cummins but well outside off. Called a wide
Pushed quicker on off stump, he steers to the left of short third to get off the mark

Slogged away but only as far as Shanaka at deep midwicket and Reddy's fun ends. Jadeja celebrates, RR celebrate... is that the game? Darted on a length at 99.9kph on off stump. Reddy wanted to deposit that over deep midwicket, but got it right off the toe-end of the bat and as far as Shanaka who ran in and took a good catch
Quicker at 95kph on middle and leg, he ticks this to wide long-on
Gives himself room to the slower length ball on off, Reddy mistimes to long-off
Pushed quicker on off stump, he flicks to the left of deep midwicket for a couple of runs
Marginally short outside off, he carves to deep cover
Slower ball, full outside off, eased to deep point

Cracking shot down the ground! 50-run stand up in 19 deliveries as Arora waits on this attempted slower yorker that's not quite full enough. Thrashes it right back. Brijesh sticks out his right hand but the ball had flown past him already
Length ball wide of off, Reddy heaves it through midwicket and they easily pick up a single
Short ball angled into him, Arora helps it along to deep backward square with a pull
Looks for the wide yorker, and the ball goes just wide of the tramline
Short ball jags in from outside off and Arora waits on it before pulling it away in front of the deep square leg fielder
Salil Arora joins in on the fun! In the slot from Brijesh and Arora helps it along over square leg

Reddy has not thrown in the towel just yet! This is tossed up on a length on off, Reddy gets in position early and nails the reverse-sweep over backward point. Klaasen missed this and was out lbw, but Reddy doesn't miss. He's ensuring that SRH don't stray too far from the asking rate, even when they are five wickets down
Reddy on fire! Half-tracker on off and he rocks back and nails the pull over midwicket. 100 up for SRH in the ninth over
Blocks this full ball towards cover
Backs away to this half-tracker crunches it over cover! Frees his arms and slaps it away
On a length outside off, Reddy skips down and works it to long-on
Tossed up full outside leg, he backs away and drives it down to long-on
Full outside off, he thrashes a drive to long-off
Short ball angled across, pulled away to deep square leg's right

Taps this length ball in front on the off side and takes off. Ferreira at cover runs towards it from cover and side-foots it towards the stumps at the non-striker's end. His finishing not quite like Viktor Gyokeres, and Salil survives again

Length ball outside leg, Reddy skips leg side and steers this towards short third and takes off for the single. Salil would have been caught short if there was a direct hit at the striker's end but Shanaka misses the stumps
Short and wide again, and Reddy punishes him again! This time he stands tall and flat-bats it straight down the ground
Reddy greets Mishra with an authoritative slap over cover! Short and wide and Reddy shows him what'll happen if he bowls those! Crunched away!
Tossed up full and wide, driven out to deep point

Oh, he's missed a reverse and he's hit in front of the stumps. Punja is convinced although the umpire isn't. RR review. That's pitched around middle on a length and it's spins towards what would have been Klaasen's off stump. But Klaasen shapes for the reverse-slog and misses. And ball-tracking shows the ball crashing into off-stump! That could well be the game, if it wasn't decided already! A big moment for young Yash Raj Punja, who has gotten SRH's spin-basher!
Oh, that's an exquisite shot! It's dropped short and finishing outside leg but Klaasen backs away a long long way and hits a back-foot punch over cover! Off a spinner!
Sweeps this full ball from outside off to deep midwicket
Floats this full delivery down the leg side
Legbreak dropped short outside off, Klaasen backs away and flat-bats it down to long-off
On a length around middle and off, Reddy backs away and pulls it to deep midwicket's right

Dug in short and Klaasen jabs it away through midwicket. Long-on has a long distance to cover to keep it down to two. SRH finish the powerplay with nine runs fewer than RR and having lost four more wickets
Backs away to this length ball angling down leg and just nudges it through the gap at backward square leg
Short ball angled into him, doesn't get it away quite as nicely as he'd have liked it, but Reddy manages to pull it out to deep square leg on the bounce
On a length outside off, 139.3kph, punched to cover
Full around off, Klaasen with a nice drive down the ground. Long-on gets across to keep it to a single
Short ball angled into him, Reddy pulls it in the gap between mid-on and midwicket
Nicely finds the gap does Reddy. Back of length outside off and Reddy goes on the back foot to punch it straight of the cover fielder
On a length just outside off, steered to deep third

Oh Archer you beauty! Knocks Travis Head over, and RR know they are almost there! Archer has been too fast for SRH today. 150kph, and slightly fuller, as Head again backs away, exposing his stumps. The ball crashes into top of off as Head is beaten completely. That's a third for Archer, who has been almost as good in the powerplay with the ball for RR as Sooryavanshi was with the bat. Alright, maybe I'm exaggerating, but you get the point
Head again backs away to a short-ish ball and looks to cut it away but hits it straight to point
Now Head backs away to this back of length delivery on leg and slaps it away square. Goes through the fielder at point and SRH pick up a much needed boundary
Back of length around leg, punched to cover
Length ball around middle and leg, Klaasen inside-edges it onto his pads. Stunning over from Burger. A wicket and just a wide conceded!
Length ball angled across, blocked back to Burger. A nice South African battle on here
Another short ball, this time angled across him, Klaasen looks to pull and is beaten on height. But it's called wide for height
Bumped in short on leg, 135kph, Klaasen gloves it down

And SRH lose another! Smaran looks to take on this 140kph length ball and swing it down the ground, but doesn't quite time it. Goes high in the air and Archer backpedals from mid-on to take a good catch above his head
Backs away to this length ball and looks to hit it down the ground. Doesn't connect, with the ball veering away
Length ball outside off seams in, blocked towards cover
Length ball angled across, Smaran pushes at it with an open blade and is lucky that the ball goes wide of the slip fielder. Goes to deep third on the bounce

Oh no, Kishan's fun is over! Jofra Archer gets his revenge! It's a big wicket. Length ball angled across at 150kph, inviting Kishan to try and cut. He's beaten for pace as he throws the kitchen sink at that. The ball balloons off the toe end to cover for a simple catch. Jadeja will be relieved!

Takes on the pull and skies it, but it's dropped and dropped outside the rope for six! Short on off and angled across and Kishan gets a top edge that ends up sending the ball very high. Jadeja has to move to his right, but misjudges it and shells it
Full outside off, Kishan now drives it to cover

And now whipped over deep backward square! A man on a mission, is Ishan Kishan! This is not quite overpitched but Kishan still picks it up and flicks it high over the fielder in the deep. Archer struck second ball today, but he's travelled for runs since!
Back of length ball with just enough width on offer for Kishan's eyes to light up. Those fast hands come into play as he cuts this over backward point
Oh the chase is well and truly on, as of now! Backs away to this length ball outside off and flays it between cover and mid-off

Deep square leg can only backpedal and watch this fly over him! Head takes on a short ball rising into him after jagging in from outside off. He backs away leg-side and pulls it flat but high enough over the fielder in the deep
Length ball outside off, 143kph, Head taps it towards mid-on for the single
Full outside off, punched to cover
Length ball jagging in from outside off, Head swings it away off the bottom half of the bat to deep midwicket
Oh that's beaten everyone and raced away for four! Inswinger full and going down leg at 142.7kph. Jurel dives at full stretch but it's beaten him too
Length ball swinging and seaming into Head, who backs away and tucks it into the midwicket region
Oh, Kishan you beauty! Goes for the wide yorker, but Kishan gets down low and opens the blade to get under the ball and carve it away through point
Sliced over the cordon! Full and across Kishan, who flashes at it with hard hands. Thick outside edge and it goes well over a leaping first slip fielder
This time, Kishan middles it! In the slot around middle and leg and Kishan whips it away into the stands over square leg

Kishan is having none of it! This is an outswinger on a length and Kishan doesn't care about the early wicket as he looks to swing this away over square leg. The ball doesn't carry though, and stops after bouncing short of the boundary as deep backward square comes across

Oh, has he edged that down the leg side? Yes, it's given! Archer is away in celebration. Short down leg at 148.5kph, and Abhishek is cramped for room as he looks to flick it leg side. Gets a thin top edge and Jurel gobbles it up
Oooh, a mis-hit to start. This is a length ball angled across and Abhishek looks to loft this over cover. Hits it off the bottom of the bat and it loops to mid-off's right
